name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Kaissenhof
beschreibung: The Kaissenhof in Ebbs is a working farm offering inviting holiday apartments. The accommodations are thoughtfully appointed with a combined kitchen-living area, comfortable bedroom, and private bathroom. Guests can unwind in the spacious garden equipped with outdoor seating. Situated in a peaceful setting on the outskirts of Ebbs in the Tyrolean Unterland, the property allows quick access to the nearby towns of Kufstein and Kiefersfelden. Scenic hiking trails and cross-country ski tracks start right nearby, making the farm a wonderful retreat for couples and families alike.
